examples.description: Dry-run a bimonthly VAT return before filing

description: Dry-run a proposed regulatory action with NO upstream side effect (no government call). Use it BEFORE a live execute to catch missing delegations and payload-shape errors. Returns `outcome`: `all_passed` (boolean), five ordered `checks` (each with `passed` and a reason) and the DRY_RUN_DISCLAIMER (a pass is NOT a guarantee of upstream success), plus the preview echo `would_be_payload` + `preview_notice`. Inputs match the /v1/actions/execute body: { org_number, action_type (`mva_melding` | `a_melding`), period, payload }; the nested `payload` mirrors the upstream government payload schema, so it is not flattened. Failure modes: a credential without `read:actions` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). VALIDATION_FAILED on invalid input. To file a sandbox VAT return, use submit_vat_return instead; under a sandbox bearer this tool returns SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE, and for a sandbox dry-run you call submit_vat_return without an approval_token. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/mva-filing
description_nb: Kjør Apiers validator for prøveinnsending mot en foreslått regulatorisk handling UTEN oppstrøms sideeffekt: `outcome.all_passed` med fem sjekker (`passed` per sjekk), DRY_RUN_DISCLAIMER og forhåndsvisningen `would_be_payload` + `preview_notice`. Bruk FØR utførelse i drift. Inndata: { org_number, action_type, period, payload }. Feilutfall: for en nøkkel uten `read:actions` vises ikke verktøyet i MCP, og et kall avvises som et ukjent verktøy (JSON-RPC -32602); VALIDATION_FAILED ved ugyldig inndata. For å levere en mva-melding i sandkassen, bruk submit_vat_return i stedet. Ingen sandkassespeil; under en sandkassenøkkel returneres SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.

action_type.description: The regulatory action to dry-run — `mva_melding` (VAT return) or `a_melding` (employer report).

org_number.description: 9-digit Norwegian organisasjonsnummer (passing MOD-11) the proposed action targets.

payload.description: The upstream-shaped JSON payload for the action; the route's per-action discriminated Zod owns shape validation. Capped at 64 KiB UTF-8 here.

name: validate_action

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The structured dry-run verdict: the overall `valid` boolean, the five check slots (each pass/fail/skipped with a reason), the DRY_RUN_DISCLAIMER, and the preview echo `would_be_payload` + `preview_notice`. No upstream side effect.
